title: The exact profile Fisher price is coercive in the amplitude l2 mass

fisher_coercivity.variables: Set r_(N,k)=sqrt(omega_k^2+kappa_N)/N and t_(N,k)=eta rho_(N,k)r_(N,k) in (0,1).
fisher_coercivity.l2_floor: The pointwise inequality t/(1-t)>=4t^2 gives C_(F,N)>=2eta^2N sum_k rho_(N,k)^2r_(N,k)^3.
fisher_coercivity.small_coupling: For 0<g<=8sqrt(3), r_(N,k)^3>=(sqrt(3)/4)^3=3sqrt(3)/64 on the selected shell.
fisher_coercivity.large_coupling: For g>=8sqrt(3), K1658 gives r_(N,k)^3>=(g/2)^(3/2) for all sufficiently large N.
fisher_coercivity.scope_guard: This controls the translated-component Fisher term; output-score coercivity still uses K1662 and the result is not unrestricted.
